description: Pilot task set T01-T24 (formerly hard-coded in src/tasks.py). kind: rotate | rotate_hat | translate_up | jump | body | flutter | human; amp is degrees (rotate*) or pixels. 'pivot' overrides the part pivot (T14 rotates the hat about the brim end).

tasks.instruction: Make the boy on the far left wave his raised hand, bending at the wrist.
Make the girl with pigtails wave her raised forearm from the elbow.
Make the small boy in the striped shirt wave his raised hand from the wrist.
Make the girl in the white dress (far right) wave her raised forearm from the elbow.
Make the toddler in the red jacket wave her raised hand from the wrist.
Make the toddler in the navy jacket swing his whole raised arm from the shoulder.
Make the red earrings of the girl in the white dress (far right) swing gently, as if in a breeze.
Make the pigtails of the girl with pigtails swing side to side.
Make the boy on the far left nod his head.
Make the toddler in the navy jacket nod his head; his hat stays on his head.
Make the small boy in the striped shirt tilt his head side to side.
Make all four children wave their raised hands at the same time.
Make the toddler in the red jacket lift her hat off her head and settle it back down.
Make the toddler in the navy jacket tilt his hat up and back in greeting, pivoting on the left end of the brim (viewer's left).
Make the small boy in the striped shirt jump once; the other three children stay perfectly still.
Make the toddler in the red jacket jump; the other toddler stays perfectly still.
Make the girl with pigtails squat down and stand back up.
Make the toddler in the navy jacket bounce at the knees.
Make the lace veil of the girl in the white dress (far right) flutter in the wind.
Make the boy on the far left wave with his left hand.
Make the toddler in the red jacket wave with her right hand.
Make the toddler in the navy jacket give a thumbs up with his raised hand.
Make the small boy in the striped shirt walk in place.
Make the toddler in the red jacket clap her hands.
